criteria.D2_model_error_blind: uses no residual, NRMSE or qualification label
criteria.D3_dimensionless: the score carries no physical unit
criteria.D4_unit_scale_invariant: invariant under c -> k*c for any nonzero constant k
criteria.D5_sign_symmetric: excursions below and above the calibration hull are treated alike
criteria.D6_constructor_generic: defined identically for every constructor family
criteria.D7_local: the reference support comes only from the relevant calibration interval
criteria.D8_application_aware: assesses the values actually encountered on the application interval
criteria.D9_monotone: greater departure from calibration support cannot improve the score
criteria.D10_auditable: one equation and one short paragraph
criteria.D12_degenerate_safe: zero-range / zero-scale calibration receives an explicit status
criteria.D13_not_special_cased: no reference to gasa, products or any Epoch-1 identity
criteria.D14_partial_application_semantics: failure means the relation is not empirically supported on that block, not that the coordinate is globally meaningless

selection_basis_permitted: broad behaviour over the coordinate universe
